minutes.headline: Conservation Commission approved the Cross Road homes and continued the DPW fuel tank, bridge, dock and pool hearings.
minutes.summary: Remote meeting with eleven hearings plus enforcement items. Several projects were approved, and others were continued for better plans, a DEP file number or more data. Enforcement votes stayed one fine, set a filing deadline for stairs and a dock on Lake Shirley, and fined another property owner.

public_comment.topic: Abutter said a 4-foot culvert at a neighbouring driveway was required for the flood plain and accepted the commission's recommendation on 63 Cross Road.
Applicant at 181 Reservoir Road objected that the plan request came months after the building department filing.
Pleasant Street resident asked whether pavement milling mulch near the brook is ground asphalt that could leach oil.
Resident of Pleasant Street asked about pre-cast versus cast-in-place work, land takings and bank disturbance on the bridge project.
Abutter on Lake Shirley said activity on the esker is growing around the unapproved dock and stairs.

what_happened.line: The Conservation Commission approved single-family home applications at 63 and 57 Cross Road, plus 90 Hemlock Drive and a field change at 4 Sunset Lane.
The commission continued the DPW culvert and fuel tank hearing, the Pleasant Street bridge hearing and the 155 Reservoir Road pool hearing to July 1.
The 392 Sunset Lane dock hearing was continued pending depth data and a site visit.
On enforcement, the commission set a filing deadline for the Lake Shirley stairs and dock, with fines possible if it is missed, and fined 1275 Mass Ave and required an RDA.
A fine at 9 Valley Road was suspended so the agent could work with the homeowner.

why_it_matters: Work near brooks, lakes and wetlands in town is reviewed here, so the continued culvert, fuel tank and bridge hearings show when those public works projects may move ahead and what review they face.
Enforcement votes show that unpermitted work near water can lead to fines and filing deadlines for the property owner.
